game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Archive variation 6: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for General-purpose languages.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.

topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification
